constraints: per-region advisory lock for capacity allocation
server instance ID cannot be reused while active sessions remain
cross-region allocation is rejected until a transfer workflow exists

knownLimitations: Only trusted internal routes are implemented; player-facing login/authentication and matchmaking gateway are not implemented.
RIDGE_SERVER_EVENT_TOKEN is a shared internal service token; production requires per-server credentials/rotation and deployment secret management.
A server_id identifies one running server process and must be unique per process boot.
Cross-region session transfer is rejected with SESSION_REGION_TRANSFER_REQUIRED; a transfer workflow is not implemented yet.
A session allocation does not create a signed client access ticket.
Unreal Engine 5.8 C++/UHT/PIE/Dedicated Server runtime has not been run in this environment.
